axis: bare marking of early age → youth as vigour and freshness

members.tone: Warm and direct, counting no years at all but the vigour and freshness that read as youth, and asserting it flatly where *youngish* hedges.
Puts youth forward as a resemblance rather than a fact, so the freshness carries the whole of the claim.
Literary and elevated where *young* and *youthful* are plain, admiring the vigour rather than merely reporting it.
Warmth sits in the diminutive: the child or young animal is made endearing, where *small* only measures.
Plain and unsentimental about the same young creature as *little*, sized rather than cherished.
Neutral and intensifying, pushing youth to its very beginning and saying how far along rather than how it looks.
Youth felt as softness, the immaturity something breakable rather than something admired.
Purely classificatory, sorting by who is taken in or aimed at, with none of the approval in *youthful*.
Mildly fond, measuring against a young boy whether the thing suits one or simply resembles one.
Hedged and faintly grudging, granting youth only approximately where *young* grants it outright.
